caseStudies.name: Milan
caseStudies.tagline: AI-powered Indian Sign Language learning app, live on Google Play
bullets: ISLRTC-verified sign dictionary, structured lessons, real-time practice feedback, and daily streaks.
98%+ gesture recognition with a dual-model pipeline: Dynamic Time Warping for temporal signs, Random Forest for static gestures from MediaPipe hand landmarks.
Privacy-first: on-device TFLite inference gives zero-latency offline feedback.

caseStudies.name: Project Wayfinder
caseStudies.tagline: Offline accessibility suite: obstacle detection, depth, and sign language in one app
bullets: 20+ FPS on-device obstacle detection across a 20 m range by fusing YOLO boxes with MiDaS depth maps and prioritized TTS alerts.
Hardware-free: everything runs on a phone, fully offline.
Extends Milan with speech-to-text input and concurrent audio guidance.

caseStudies.name: NameGate
caseStudies.tagline: Tokenized bonds with ENSv2 subnames as an on-chain compliance layer
bullets: Permissionless beacon contract reads ENS resolver records and relays KYC state cross-chain via Chainlink CCIP, with role-scoped access preventing forgery by either party.
194 tests including 49 live regression tests against Sepolia and Hedera testnet.
Caught a real 8-vs-18-decimal unit mismatch between HBAR and its EVM representation.
